embeds.description: Reason : Is it mandatory to fill the attendance form every day for dijkstrains batch students from the internship offer letter.

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content:
Dear Support Team,

Is it mandatory to fill the attendance form every for dijkstrains batch students from the internship offer letter because I remember the moderators/ mentors clearly mentioning it in the  standup meeting that attendance was no more mandatory. And this announcement was made like way back in January.

This confusion is created because some other students are talking about attendance in the discussion channel.

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content:
Hello support team,
Please help me clear this confusion.🙂🙏

messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content: The attendance form is to be filled even after making the attendance not compulsory as we have clearly mentioned in FAQ also that it is for the Reference of the NPTEL Internship team. So yes, it needs to be filled.

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content:
But I am not filling the attendance form from the day after the announcement was made in the standup meeting. 
What will happen now ? 

And even after the announcement  it is still mentioned in the FAQ that it is compulsory to attend the standup meeting.

So I thought that the FAQ might have not been updated regarding the attendance and I thought since the attendance is not compulsory I don't need to fill the attendance form from the offer.

messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content: Please refer to the FAQ question about attendance form.

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content:
What do I do now? 
What will happen now?

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content: It says I need to fill the form everyday except Sunday.

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content:
But I wanted to know if there is any problem since I have not been filling the attendance form. Will I be able to complete my internship? 
Will I get a certificate of completion?

messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content: For this, you need to contact NPTEL Internship team whom sent you the offer letter. We have clearly mentioned in the FAQ and in the announcements that this is to be filled even though we are relaxing the attendance

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content: Ok sir I will mail them

messages.author: shreshthkumar_09
messages.content: But what about the standup meeting and live sessions is it still compulsory as mentioned in the FAQ  or is it not compulsory as announced in the standup meeting.

messages.author: nitin_fighter1379
messages.content: It is not compulsory as mentioned in the standup.
